## Summary

Describe the laboratory or maintenance change and its scientific boundary.

## Validation

- [ ] Quick GitHub Actions passed on the final head SHA.
- [ ] Full GitHub Actions passed on the final head SHA.
- [ ] LaTeX GitHub Actions passed on the final head SHA.

## Copilot review gate

- [ ] GitHub Copilot completed a pull-request review of the final diff.
- [ ] The review summary, inline threads, suppressed findings, and top-level comments were inspected.
- [ ] Every finding was classified.
- [ ] Every actionable finding was fixed and covered by a regression check when practical.
- [ ] No unresolved actionable Copilot thread remains.

Any commit after CI or Copilot review requires both gates to be run again before promotion.

## Scientific boundary

State explicitly what this PR does not prove, including publication, novelty, unrestricted avoidance, lower-bound, and P-versus-NP nonclaims where relevant.
